description: BFVZ POWERHealth is a schedule health analysis visual for Power BI that performs automated DCMA 14-point assessments across multi-project programs. THE PROBLEM Project controls teams spend hours every update cycle manually evaluating schedule quality — checking for missing logic, negative float, overallocated resources, and missed baselines across hundreds or thousands of tasks. The results live in spreadsheets that are outdated by the time they reach leadership. Meanwhile, schedulers know their resource plan is infeasible but have no fast way to identify which conflicts are resolvable and which require management decisions. WHO THIS IS FOR POWERHealth is built for project controls professionals, PMO analysts, program managers, schedulers, and construction managers who manage CPM-driven schedules and need to assess, communicate, and act on schedule health — without leaving Power BI. It serves any industry that uses predecessor-linked scheduling: energy, utilities, telecom, pipeline, water infrastructure, data center construction, oil and gas, transportation, and commercial building programs. WHAT IT DOES Connect your schedule data and instantly see a weighted health grade, 14 traffic-light metrics, and a sortable risk register — all updating in real time as your data changes.
